title: WoDX Combat
description: World of Darkness Expanded: combat with actor-type profiles for every line: attack, defense, damage, soak (silver, cold iron, Fortitude, armor), health track, Rage extra actions, V20 Dark Ages maneuvers and WoDX conditions. Private use only; not for distribution or sale. Shots and reloads can be counted (a house rule that starts off): one round a shot from a weapon with a capacity, one turn to reload a firearm, longer for a crossbow.

requires.reason: Conditions, timed effects, the approval queue and search boxes.
